description: It is bittersweet to announce that I have left the Environmental Protection Agency. Most of my work in the last 9 years has supported this agency either directly or indirectly, so it's difficult to make the change to do something different. I can't state enough how much I admire and respect the people I've worked with at EPA, and I call many of them personal friends. But with all the difficult changes still happening in the agency, it feels like it's time for me to try making a positive impact on human health and the environment somewhere new. I'll post an update regarding my new position when I start it, but for now, I want to acknowledge the end of this chapter and emphasize my deep appreciation for the work I was able to do at EPA and the relationships that developed along the way. Thank you, current and former EPA-ers!
